mainEntity.name: How do I create a QR code for my form?

acceptedAnswer.text: Build your form, survey, or RSVP page in Formester, then use the Generate QR Code option to create a QR code linked to it. Customize the style and download it, then place it anywhere people can scan to open your form.

mainEntity.name: Can I create a free RSVP QR code for events?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can create a free RSVP QR code for event registrations, weddings, or meetups. Guests scan it with their phone camera and confirm attendance in seconds — no link to type and no app to install.

mainEntity.name: Where can I use my QR code after creating it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Anywhere people can see it. Add it to posters, flyers, invitations, packaging, table tents, emails, websites, or social media. Anyone who scans it is taken straight to your form or page.

mainEntity.name: Can I customize my QR code design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can adjust the style, color, and format of the QR code and download it so it matches your brand or print design.

mainEntity.name: Is the QR code generator free to use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can generate and download QR codes for your forms, surveys, and RSVP pages for free.

mainEntity.name: Will the QR code work on all devices?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. QR codes can be scanned using any smartphone camera or QR scanner app and work smoothly across iPhone, Android, and tablets.

components.description: Generate a QR code for any form in seconds, style it to fit your design, and download it ready for print or screen. People scan and the form opens — no links to type, no friction.

cards.title: Instant QR for any form
cards.body: Turn any Formester form, survey, or RSVP page into a QR code with one click. People point their phone camera at it and your form opens instantly — no app, no typing a link.
cards.mockHtml: Form opens

cards.title: Customize style, color & format
cards.body: Match the QR code to your brand or print piece — adjust its style and color, then download in the format you need so it looks right on a flyer, poster, or screen.

cards.title: Download & print anywhere
cards.body: Download the QR code and drop it onto posters, flyers, invitations, packaging, or table tents. It stays crisp at any size, so it scans reliably whether it's on a card or a banner.
cards.mockHtml: qr-rsvp.png · downloaded

cards.title: Zero technical work
cards.body: No coding, no separate QR tool, and no design skills. The code lives next to your form, so updating the form behind it never changes the code you've already printed.
cards.mockHtml: No codeNo extra toolOne click

cards.title: Scans on every device
cards.body: Any smartphone camera or QR scanner app opens the form — iPhone, Android, or tablet. The form itself is fully responsive, so it looks right the moment it loads on their screen.

cards.title: Collect responses on the spot
cards.body: People respond in the moment they see the code — at an event, a store exit, or on packaging — instead of remembering a URL later. Every scan that converts lands in your dashboard.

components.heading: Generate your form's QR code in four steps
components.description: Build your form, generate its QR code, style it, and share it. People scan to open the form — every response flows straight back to Formester.

steps.title: Build your form, survey, or RSVP page
steps.description: Create what you want people to fill out in Formester — an event RSVP, a feedback survey, a donation page, or any form.

steps.title: Download & share it anywhere

components.description: A QR code meets people in the physical world — on a poster, a table, or a package — and opens your form on the device already in their hand.

cards.title: RSVPs on invitations & posters
cards.body: Weddings, workshops, and corporate gatherings make RSVPs tricky. Add an RSVP QR code to invitations or posters and guests confirm attendance in seconds from their phone.

cards.title: Feedback at the point of experience
cards.body: Place a feedback survey QR code at store exits, on receipts, on tables, or on packaging. Customers scan and share their opinion right then, so you collect far more responses.

cards.title: Donations from a single scan
cards.body: Link a donation form to a QR code and print it on flyers, banners, or event programs. Supporters scan and give on the spot — perfect for fundraisers and offline campaigns.

cards.title: Surveys in class or at a workshop
cards.body: Distribute a survey by QR code during a class, session, or workshop. Participants scan and complete it immediately on their own device, lifting participation and speeding up data collection.

testimonials.name: Jilson
testimonials.comment: Formester is really easy to use and an exceptional alternative for Typeform. We use it for call for papers, lead registrations, feedback and surveys and it cannot be simpler.

testimonials.name: Deanna Bugalski
testimonials.comment: I was searching for a long time for a product I could use to send newsletters and surveys to my database. I tried so many different types of software and I found many of them difficult to use and slow to learn how to operate. But Formester was super easy to set up, and the usability is seamless! I highly recommend!

testimonials.name: Bency
testimonials.comment: Formester's AI form generator transformed how quickly we build forms. The drag-and-drop builder paired with AI-generated templates means I can spin up a survey or poll in minutes, not hours. Conditional logic, file uploads, and seamless integrations make it incredibly versatile and the customization options let every form match our branding perfectly. Their support team is exceptional too. It's the only form and survey tool we recommend

testimonials.name: Roger
testimonials.comment: I use Formester for my form-building needs and I’m thoroughly impressed. The platform is rich with features… What really sets them apart is their exceptional customer service (responses typically within 10 minutes). The pricing is also very reasonable… Highly recommended!

testimonials.name: Ye Qi Lai
testimonials.comment: Formester is one of the best underrated survey tools out there… It’s extremely customizable… Their support is awesome… I absolutely recommend this to anyone looking for an alternative to the usual form creators.

testimonials.name: Thibaud Martinez
testimonials.comment: I really enjoy Formester. It’s clean and straight-forward and it does well, what it is supposed to do.
